description:
Backup power gets expensive fast when you buy the wrong system.

I’m Mike Donnelly, a retired generator service technician helping homeowners understand what actually matters before buying portable generators, standby systems, and backup-power equipment.

We cover sizing, startup loads, fuel, transfer switches, maintenance, storage, placement, noise, and the mistakes that leave people without power when they need it most.

No marketing hype. Just practical backup-power advice.

Buyer Guide:
https://revqor.com/mike-backup-power-buyer
